chunks: Salama ibn Muhammad narrated to us, saying: Abu al-Hasan Ali ibn Umar, known as al-Haji, narrated to us, saying: Hamza ibn al-Qasim al-Alawi al-Abbasi al-Razi narrated to us, saying: Ja'far ibn Muhammad al-Hasani narrated to us, saying: Ubayd ibn Kathir narrated to us, saying: Abu Ahmad ibn Musa al-Asadi narrated to us, from Dawud ibn Kathir al-Raqqi, saying:

I entered upon Abu Abdillah Ja'far ibn Muhammad in Medina, and he said to me: 'What has delayed you, O Dawud, from us?' I said: 'A need arose for me in Kufa.' He said: 'Whom did you leave there?' I said: 'May I be your ransom, I left your uncle Zayd there. I left him riding a horse with a sword across his shoulders, calling out in a loud voice: 'Ask me, ask me before you lose me. Between my ribs is vast knowledge; I know the abrogating and the abrogated, the oft-repeated verses, and the Great Qur'an, and I am the knowledge between Allah and you.' He said to me: 'O Dawud, the various paths have carried you away.'

Then he called out: 'O Suma'ah ibn Mihran, bring me a basket of ripe dates.' He brought him a basket containing ripe dates. He took a date, ate it, extracted the pit from his mouth, and planted it in the ground. It split, sprouted, grew, and fruited abundantly. He reached with his hand to a date from a cluster, split it, and extracted a white parchment from it. He spread it out, handed it to me, and said: 'Read it.' I read it, and found two lines in it; the first line was: 'There is no god but Allah, Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah,' and the second was: 'Amir al-Mu'minin Ali ibn Abi Talib, al-Hasan ibn Ali, al-Husayn ibn Ali, Ali ibn al-Husayn, Muhammad ibn Ali, Ja'far ibn Muhammad, Musa ibn Ja'far, Ali ibn Musa, Muhammad ibn Ali, Ali ibn Muhammad, al-Hasan ibn Ali, the Successor, the Proof.'
Then he said: 'O Dawud, do you know when this was written in this [parchit]?' I said: 'Allah knows best, and His Messenger, and you.' He said: 'Two thousand years before Allah created Adam.'

key_terms.الْخَلَفُ الْحُجَّةُ: The Successor, the Proof (referring to the Mahdi)

ai.seo_question: What is the evidence for the pre-eternal designation of the Twelve Imams in Shia tradition?
ai.summary: In this narration from Al-Nu'mani's *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (AS) validates the scholarly authority of his uncle Zayd ibn Ali by highlighting his mastery of the Quranic sciences, specifically distinguishing between the abrogating and abrogated verses. The Imam then presents a parchment inscribed with the names of the Twelve Imams, declaring it was written two thousand years before the creation of Adam, thereby establishing their pre-eternal designation (al-Dhikr al-Awwal) and providing a foundational proof for the number and identity of the Imams in Shia tradition.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (18) Salama bin Muhammad narrated from Abul Hasan Ali bin Umar al-Haji from Hamza bin al-Qassim al-Alawi al-Abbasi ar-Razi from Ja’far bin Muhammad al-Hasani from Obayd bin Katheer from Abu Ahmad bin Musa al-Assadi that Dawood bin Katheer ar-Riqqi had said:

I came to Abu Abdullah Ja’far bin Muhammad as-Sadiq (as) in Medina and he said to me: “Why have you not visited us since so long, O Dawood?” I said: “I had something to do in Kufa.” He said: “Whom did you leave in Kufa?” I said: “May my soul be sacrificed for you! I have left your uncle Zayd. I left him riding on a horse with his sword and calling loudly: “Ask me before you will miss me. I have great knowledge. I have known the abrogating and abrogated verdicts, the oft-repeated verses and the great Qur’an. Knowledge is between Allah and you.” He said to me: “O Dawood, things have affected you!”

Then he called: “O Suma’a bin Mihran, bring me a basket of ripe dates!” He brought him a basket of ripe dates. He took one, ate it, took the kernel out of his mouth and stuck it into the ground. It grew and fruited. He picked an unripe date from one of the bunches. He split it and took a piece of parchment out of it. He spread it, gave it to me and said to me: “Read it!” It had two lines. The first line was (There is no god but Allah and Muhammad is the messenger of Allah). The second line was (Surely the number of months with Allah is twelve months in Allah’s ordinance since the day when He created the heavens and the earth, of these four being sacred; that is the right religion); Amirul Mo’mineen Ali bin Abu Talib, al-Hasan bin Ali, al-Husayn bin Ali, Ali bin al-Husayn, Muhammad bin Ali, Ja’far bin Muhammad, Musa bin Ja’far, Ali bin Musa, Muhammad bin Ali, Ali bin Muhammad, al-Hasan bin Ali, al-Khalaf al-Hujjah (al-Mahdi).

Then he said: “O Dawood, do you know when this has been written in this piece of parchment?” I said: “Allah, His messenger and you are more aware!” He said: “Two thousand years before Allah had created Adam.”
